features.name: Elaborate hilt and handguard are described as common; reviewed drawing supplies the selected published example.

Actual Arsenal printed14/PDF16 labeled RAPIER and generated detail compared. Long straight sharply pointed slender fencing blade, short one-hand grip, pommel and complex swept open guard agree. Every visible guard member and genuine open space remains distinct; no solid cup substitution or broad-sword thickening. Slight oblique depth and neutral metal/charcoal finish are artistic interpretation. Full tip/pommel fit the1254 square; RGB white background requires later independent foreground conditioning. Actual matching clay has completely smooth grip/fittings with fine cuts, wrap, fasteners and texture filled; broad blade facets and major boundaries retained. Assigned sole reviewer inspected native/final independent masks, teal views and paired overlay. Genuine frame/guard/ring openings and thin structures preserved; specular metal highlights remain foreground. No clipped tip, missing rail/bar, detached foreground, broad fringe or shadow. Raw RGB unchanged; common crop/scale/offset only. 2048 output is resampled from1254 square, not native2K. Reference approval only.
